name: Executive order of January 31, 1874 setting apart the Judith Basin reserve for the Crow
promises: Not a treaty. Pending action by Congress on the agreement of August 16, 1873, the President withdrew from entry and settlement the country drained by the Judith, Arrow and Dog rivers as a Crow reserve.
today: Royce records that the order was revoked on March 25, 1875 because the Crow refused to move and Congress did not ratify the agreement. The Crow kept their 1868 reservation; no land was taken by this order.

openQuestions: Under the 2026-11-08 rule the 1875 revocation of this executive-order reserve is not by itself a breach; it has its own record (cession-1875-03-25-crow).
The unratified agreement is recorded under cession-1873-08-16-crow.
